_meta.name: nab task-engine bench.1 corpus — v2 (moat: data-heavy / multi-item)
_meta.purpose: Tasks where the answer is a LIST or structured slice of a heavy page. The browser must render+ingest the whole page (many items + chrome); nab gets a shaped API response. This is the moat case, not trivial single-fact lookups.
_meta.baseline: live headless Chrome over CDP, validity-checked (browser_answer_contains must render; bot-walls/shells = browser failure)
_meta.note: api_hint recorded for the nab runner only; the browser is never handed it.
